summary.intent: Update the project setup to reflect the GitHub repo rename from orin-dx/agent-plugins to orin-dx/wisp-plugins, including renaming the local checkout folder.
summary.outcome: Local folder renamed to wisp-plugins, origin remote repointed to https://github.com/orin-dx/wisp-plugins.git, and current install commands, marketplace source URLs, and generated Codex manifests updated. just check passed (49 tests) and pre-existing user changes were preserved.

repo: Install commands, Claude marketplace manifests, and Codex source manifests all embed the repo path and must be updated on a rename.
Migration notes, the changelog, and an ADR reference the old name intentionally; historical text is left as written.
The old marketplace selector is kept in migration instructions so users can remove earlier registrations.
`just check` is the validation entry point and runs the test suite (49 tests).

code.finding: Existing Python test was updated to assert the new repo URLs; it is the only file modified in the repo.

workflow: Use simple shell commands (sed, mv, git remote set-url) for mechanical text replacements and folder checks rather than ad hoc Python scripts.
Keep one-off helper scripts out of the repo; run them in the shell only and don't save them.
Separate current references (update) from historical references (preserve) when handling a rename.
